headline: Executive order launching a federal effort called the National Export Initiative, aimed at increasing U.S. exports.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order creates a National Export Initiative, a federal effort focused on U.S. exports. No summary was provided, so the specific programs, agencies, and goals involved are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: U.S. businesses that sell or want to sell goods and services abroad
who_it_affects.how: They are the likely focus of a federal effort to support exports, though the specific help offered is not described in the available material.
They would likely be directed to carry out the initiative, but the order's exact assignments are not described in the available material.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 11, 2010; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
